named_question: Can the role-independent native MixMod checkbox start from an omitted attribute without inventing a default or inserting no-op storage?

static_byte_pins.purpose: Constructor initializes zero across +0x94/+0x98, including MixMod; nearby independent flags and numeric identities are also zeroed.
Boolean reader stores the result of equality with the TRUE literal.
NUL-terminated TRUE literal; string comparison is case-insensitive.

reused_contract.retained: Actual row-bound column5 toggle, SID1..31 checkbox eligibility, unique selected numeric SID and CID12..19 graph/role boundary remain unchanged. The earlier explicit-flag-only CLI subset remains historical; this artifact extends only omitted MixMod.
reused_contract.not_proof: The static/CLI-authored CID0/MixMod=false native case input is not a native default observation.

source_contract.member: The XML binder identifies MixMod as boolean type0 at selected record+0x98, with optional attribute binding and param7=0.
source_contract.constructor: The native constructor zeroes the eight bytes at+0x94, including MixMod at+0x98.
source_contract.missing_read: The common reader clears its temporary string, copies an attribute only if found and, with param7=0, still enters boolean conversion for missing input. Empty is not case-insensitively equal to TRUE, so omission reads false.
source_contract.boundary: This proves the stored model default, not role-forced displayed state or full native import/permissions. CID12..19 remains rejected even on false no-op.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-mix FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME (--mix | --no-mix)
CLI_policy.new_input: Omitted MixMod is supported with effective/default false. Explicit input is still restricted to canonical true/false; numeric, opaque and other spellings are not silently defaulted or normalized.
CLI_policy.no_op: A false request on omitted MixMod preserves omission and exact in-place bytes. JSON before/after are null, before_effective/default false, enabled false and changed false.
CLI_policy.change: A true request on omitted MixMod writes only selected MixMod=true through the existing writer. Explicit before/after values and existing CSV column order are unchanged.
CLI_policy.preservation: Retain all other flags/records, identity spellings, counts/widths/order, Qn, SName, capabilities, LSConfig, HCL, sequences and unknown storage. No role/default/cohort inference beyond this recovered flag default.
CLI_policy.shared_parser: SkipNext and MixMod share the same conservative canonical-or-omitted default-false parser; SkipNext behavior is unchanged.
